tasks.short: Monitor pumps and flow lines for leaks.

steps.what: Inspect pumps and flow lines for gas and fluid leaks
outputs: actual observed leak signs and location

steps.what: Review actual leak alarms and determine the required operating response
inputs: actual observed leak signs and location
outputs: actual leak assessment and chosen response

steps.what: Enter and check actual leak observations in the existing inspection record
inputs: actual observed leak signs and location
actual leak assessment and chosen response
actual equipment identifier and inspection time

steps.what: Save the checked final leak inspection record

tasks.design: Configure the existing inspection form in {OPS_SYSTEM} to reuse the selected equipment identifier and actual inspection timestamp. The pumper still inspects, assesses leaks and checks the final observation before saving it.
tasks.previous_blocker: An existing inspection log can repeat equipment identification and observation entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Native asset context and coded observation fields can reduce repeated entry.
tasks.still_hard: Small leaks and unsafe conditions require field observation and operating judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The pumper recognises actual equipment condition and follows the site's response procedure.
tasks.altitude: Less inspection entry; no change to operating authority.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: asset-linked inspection forms can reuse identifiers and timestamps; existing alarms do not replace visual leak checks.

assumptions: Boundary is monitoring and its actual existing inspection record. Emergency calls, shutdowns or repairs are separate actual authorised response actions; no avoided response labour is claimed.
The pumper supplies actual leak observations and verifies equipment and time in s3. No sensor installation, automatic leak diagnosis or free digitisation is assumed.
Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. If no inspection record exists, omit s3/s4 and reweight physical monitoring: zero saving. Already configured forms earn zero saving.
The routine save retains one percent; its gate uses the existing final record check with no extra self-approval work.
unknowns: Is a separate inspection record actually required?
research_questions: Does native asset context reduce actual record entry without reducing field coverage?

approvals.approved_version: s3 checked final inspection record and exact asset destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 4*0.50 = 2; minus 0.5 upkeep = 1.5. At half the record entry eligible, 1 minus 0.5 = 0.5. No saving in field monitoring, judgement or save.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Monitor pumping pressure, density, rate and concentration.

steps.what: Monitor control panels for actual pressure, density, rate and concentration during pumping
Assess deviations and choose the required operating response
outputs: actual deviation assessment and chosen response

steps.what: Enter and verify actual pumping readings and observations in the existing operating log
inputs: actual deviation assessment and chosen response
actual historian values with equipment, time and units

steps.what: Save the checked final pumping log entry

tasks.design: Use native historian-to-log mappings in {OPS_SYSTEM} for actual recorded values and units. The pumper keeps live monitoring, deviation assessment and narrative observations, then checks and saves the final log entry.
tasks.previous_blocker: A separate operating log may duplicate actual panel readings.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing historian exports and native log mappings can remove duplicate numerical entry.
tasks.still_hard: Sensor validity, transient conditions and correct operating responses require an operator.
tasks.human_edge: The pumper combines readings with actual operating context and detects misleading instruments.
tasks.altitude: Less duplicate logging; live operating responsibility stays unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: process historians can supply timestamped numerical readings to operating logs; this does not establish local telemetry coverage or reduce required monitoring.

assumptions: Actual installed historian must supply the correct well/pump identifier, timestamp, pressure, density, rate, concentration, units and quality flag. Pumper checks mapping and missing values in s3; unsupported observations remain manual.
Only an actual existing duplicate log is eligible. If logging is already automatic or no record is required, there is no entry saving; no new logging baseline is invented.
Boundary is monitoring, assessment and existing logging. Any actual set-point change, shutdown or escalation is a separate gated action under site procedure, with no saving claimed here.
Shares and remaining percentages are provisional scenarios. Native configuration comes first; no new sensor or model is assumed. Save is one percent fully retained and uses the existing final check.
unknowns: Are all four parameters recorded with reliable equipment identifiers?
Is numerical log entry actually duplicated?
research_questions: Can existing readings populate the required log without hiding bad-quality or missing measurements?

incremental.description: Check historian-to-log mappings and unit changes.

approvals.approved_version: s3 checked final pumping log entry and exact well record destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 9*0.50 = 4.5; minus 0.5 upkeep = 4. At half the duplicate entry eligible, 2.25 minus 0.5 = 1.75. Live monitoring and response judgement remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Retrieve actual well work status, worker availability and authorised production instructions
Prepare and check actual production work assignments
Commit the checked final production work assignments
Supervise oil pumpers and other workers during actual well production work
outputs: actual supervision observations and work outcomes

steps.what: Enter and check actual supervision observations and completed work outcomes
inputs: actual supervision observations and work outcomes

steps.what: Save the checked final supervision work record

tasks.design: Configure native work-order and availability views in {OPS_SYSTEM} and assignment defaults in {PROJECT}. The pumper chooses and checks actual assignments, commits them, supervises the work and records only actual outcomes.
tasks.previous_blocker: Supervision preparation can repeat work-order lookup and assignment field entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Native filtered views and existing work-order references can reduce preparation.
tasks.still_hard: Unsafe conditions, coaching and production priorities require on-site judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The supervisor understands worker capability and actual well conditions.
tasks.altitude: Less supervision preparation; worker direction remains human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native work-order views and assignment defaults can reduce lookup and entry, without automating field supervision.

assumptions: Existing authorised work-order owners supply actual asset, status and instructions; actual scheduling records supply availability. Pumper verifies context in s1 and chooses worker/task assignments in s2; missing information remains manual.
Actual supervision and capture of outcomes remain fully retained. Assignments are not evidence of completed work, and no worker performance score is introduced.
Only actual existing preparation and records are in scope; omit absent records and reweight. Already configured views earn no saving.
Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Each routine commit retains one percent. Exact-version gates use existing field checks, adding no self-approval work.
unknowns: How much work-order information is retrieved twice?
Does the pumper actually maintain assignment records?
research_questions: Can existing views reduce preparation without adding record-keeping?

incremental.description: Maintain work-order views and assignment defaults.

approvals.approved_version: s2 checked final work assignments and exact assignment destination; edits require recheck
s5 checked final actual supervision record and exact work-order destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 10*0.40 lookup + 9*0.20 assignment entry = 5.8; minus 0.5 upkeep = 5.3. Half eligible gives 2.9 minus 0.5 = 2.4. Supervision, outcomes and both commits stay retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Field monitoring, operating judgement and worker supervision remain with the pumper; existing record and preparation work may shrink.
role.ambitious_version: Validate actual duplicate entry before changing well monitoring or supervision workflows.
